notes:
🚀 Lassi Lounge is now faster, smarter, and more rewarding!

✨ What's New:
- 🎁 Introducing Lassi Lounge Club: Earn loyalty points on every order and redeem them for exclusive discounts!
- 🎟️ My Coupons: Redeemed coupons now always visible — apply or copy anytime, never lose a coupon!
- ⚡ Premium Skeleton Loading: Enjoy a smoother, lightning-fast app loading experience.
- 🔔 Real-time Notification Bell: Unread dot shows instantly on app open.
- 📍 Smarter Address Flow: Default address auto-loads after login and pre-selected in Cart.
- 🤝 Refer & Earn: Easily invite friends from the Offers page.

🔧 Improvements & Fixes:
- 📡 Smart Offline Banner: App now elegantly handles weak internet connections.
- ⏱️ Auto-Resolution: Stuck orders are automatically cancelled and refunded.
- 💰 Loyalty Coins section removed from Checkout — redeem via coupon on Cart instead.
- 🔒 Used coupons locked with clear status after order is placed.
- 🧭 Improved navigation for a seamless browsing experience.
